name: FlowDino
author: FlowDino

sections.description:
FlowDino is a powerful multi-platform selling tool that centralizes all your listings in a single interface and lets you publish them to the most popular second-hand and e-commerce marketplaces — Leboncoin, Vinted, Etsy, Vestiaire Collective, eBay, and more — in just a few clicks.

This WooCommerce plugin extends FlowDino’s capabilities with two additional features:

  • Sync FlowDino articles to WooCommerce — pull your FlowDino listings directly into your WooCommerce store
  • Import marketplace sales into WooCommerce — automatically bring back orders from Leboncoin, Vinted, Etsy, Vestiaire Collective, eBay, and other platforms into your WooCommerce dashboard

FlowDino Platform Features

  • Centralize all your listings in a single interface
  • Optimize your product descriptions with an AI assistant
  • Generate images of your clothing items on a virtual model
  • Automatically change image backgrounds for a professional look
  • Publish automatically to multiple platforms (Vinted, Leboncoin, eBay, Etsy, and more)
  • Renew your listings automatically to stay at the top of search results
  • Boost visibility through view and favorite exchange systems
  • Automatically send personalized messages to users who favorite your listings
  • Automatically delete your listings across all platforms in a few clicks

WooCommerce Plugin Features

  • Automatic synchronization: Syncs your products when they are created or updated
  • Manual synchronization: Bulk or individual synchronization via a dedicated interface
  • Complete admin interface: Dashboard with statistics and advanced management
  • Category mapping: Easily map your WooCommerce categories to FlowDino categories
  • Brand support: Compatible with popular brand plugins (WooCommerce Brands, Perfect Brands, YITH Brands)
  • Attribute management: Mapping for colors, materials, and sizes
  • Variable products: Full support for product variations
  • Image synchronization: Main images and galleries included
  • Stock management: Synchronization of quantities and stock statuses
  • Multilingual: Interface available in French and English
  • Dashboard: Detailed synchronization statistics
  • Sales tab: Import orders from external platforms (Vinted, Leboncoin, Etsy, eBay, Vestiaire Collective etc.) directly into WooCommerce

Use Cases

  • Online stores using WooCommerce
  • Centralized product catalog management across multiple marketplaces
  • Multi-platform synchronization (Vinted, Leboncoin, eBay, Etsy, Vestiaire Collective, and more)
  • Automation of listing publication and renewal
  • Simplified inventory and order management

Benefits

  • Time-saving: Full automation of synchronization and multi-platform publishing
  • Reliability: Robust system with error handling
  • Ease of use: Intuitive and user-friendly interface
  • Flexibility: Configurable to fit your needs
  • Support: Complete documentation and technical support

External Services

This plugin connects to the FlowDino API (https://www.flowdino.com) to synchronize your WooCommerce catalog with the FlowDino platform for centralized product management.

This service is provided by FlowDino: terms of service https://www.flowdino.com/cgu, privacy policy https://www.flowdino.com/privacy, legal notices https://www.flowdino.com/mentions-legales.

Support

For help or to report bugs:

  • Documentation: See the complete documentation included in the plugin
  • Technical support: Contact the FlowDino team via their website
  • Community: Join the discussions on the WordPress forums
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to ‘Plugins’ > ‘Add New’ in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for “FlowDino”
  3. Click ‘Install Now’
  4. Activate the plugin

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to ‘Plugins’ > ‘Add New’ > ‘Upload Plugin’
  3. Select the ZIP file and click ‘Install Now’
  4. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. Go to ‘WooCommerce’ > ‘FlowDino’ after activation
  2. Enter your FlowDino credentials in the ‘Settings’ tab
  3. Configure category and attribute mappings
  4. Run your first synchronization
sections.faq:
How do I get a FlowDino account?

Visit the FlowDino website to create your account and obtain your API credentials.

Is the plugin compatible with all WooCommerce themes?

Yes, the plugin works with all WooCommerce-compatible themes without any modifications required.

Can I synchronize existing products?

Absolutely! The plugin allows you to synchronize both existing products and new ones.

How do I resolve connection issues?

Use the built-in diagnostic tool in the ‘Help’ tab to identify and resolve connection problems.

Does the plugin support variable products?

Yes, the plugin fully supports variable products and their variations with all their attributes.

Can I synchronize only certain categories?

Yes, you can choose which categories to synchronize via the category mapping interface.

  • Sales – Fixed externalKey parsing to use site URL prefix stripping instead of fragile explode+end approach
  • Sales – Fallback no-orderLines path also resolves and links variation products via externalKey
